thread:
ariane_sales: Hey team — acme sec says they need a least-privilege flow for the POC. They want hosted API keys for devs, but with expiring tokens, SSO-linked RBAC, and no ability to download long-lived admin keys. Also asking if Dedicated pool onboarding affects pricing immediately or only when traffic starts.

devon_se: quick answer: we can do ephemeral API keys scoped to a workspace + role; Dedicated reserved billing starts when the pool is provisioned/committed (sales/legal can confirm exact billing trigger). For POC, recommended: Hosted ephemeral keys + optional Dedicated trial pool (timeboxed).

samir_security: couple of constraints from security: 1) tokens must be short ttl (<= 8h) for contractor/dev accounts, 2) token issuance must be auditable (who/when/which model), 3) SSO mapping only (SAML groups) preferred — no manual admin invites for PII projects. Also enforce outbound egress to allow only required telemetry endpoints.

maria_eng: implementation idea: issue ephemeral service tokens tied to workspace and role. Example CLI flow we use internally:
```
# create ephemeral key for user@example.com
rwctl tokens issue --workspace acme-poc --role reader --ttl 8h --scoped-model "redwood/open-lite-1"
# returns: ephemeral_key=eyJ... expires_at=2025-12-01T15:23:00Z
```
That gives audit events in the console and we log issuance to customer audit export if enabled.

ariane_sales: perfect — acme asked specifically: can we limit tokens to only embeddings + chat (no model fine-tuning or model upload)?

devon_se: yes — roles can be action-scoped. We have permission bits like: generate:chat, generate:embeddings, manage:models. For POC just give `generate:chat,generate:embeddings`.

samir_security: also check KMS for Hosted keys: acme requires CMK-backed key wrapping for any token material we persist. For Private/VPC we support customer-managed KMS; for Hosted we can enable envelope encryption with a vendor-managed CMK but need SOC/contract exception if they insist on customer key.

radeep_enablement: FYI — I can run an internal checklist with the SEs and send a minimal RBAC matrix to the buyer. Proposed minimal roles:
- poc_viewer: generate:chat,generate:embeddings, read:logs
- poc_operator: poc_viewer + manage:routes (but no manage:dedicated)
- poc_admin: full POC admin (only for 1-2 people)

ariane_sales: buyer also requested an invite flow for external contractors (short lived). Is there a UI flow or do we have to create accounts manually?

maria_eng: UI supports admin-created invites with expiry and role selection. We also have an API to automate invites if you want the partner onboarding script. Example payload:
```json
{
  "email": "contractor@partner.com",
  "role": "poc_viewer",
  "expires_in": "8h",
  "scoped_models": ["redwood/open-lite-1"]
}
```
Use the `POST /workspaces/{id}/invites` endpoint.

ariane_sales: great. Samir, is that acceptable for their security team? If not, what blocks?

samir_security: acceptable if: 1) invites are bound to SSO account (we prefer auto-accept if SAML assertion exists), 2) audit logs exported to their SIEM or retained for 90 days (they asked 365 but suggest negotiating to 90 for POC), 3) no plaintext token emails.

devon_se: note on Dedicated: we can pre-provision a small dedicated pool (1-2 GPUs) for the POC under a timeboxed reserved contract. Billing: usually starts once the dedicated pool instance is in the customer's cloud account and running (we can do trial credits to cover first 30 days). I'll loop in finance.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: created invite-template "poc-short-8h" (id: tmpl-78cd) for workspace acme-poc.

ariane_sales: action items:
- devon: confirm Dedicated billing trigger and any trial credit we can offer (assign)
- radeep: send RBAC matrix + one-pager on ephemeral token flow to buyer
- maria: share invite API example and UI screenshot (for buyer onboarding doc)
- samir: one-line acceptance criteria we can include in SQA (ephemeral TTL, audit retention, CMK note)

radeep_enablement: I'll draft the email now and post the one-pager in the deal slack thread.

samir_security: my sample SQA lines: "Tokens for POC must be short-lived (<=8h), issuance and revocation are logged and exported; customer may request CMK-backed key wrapping for persisted secrets; SSO group mapping enforced for role assignment."

ariane_sales: thanks everyone — I'll update the acme contact and we should be ready for the kickoff tomorrow. :thumbsup:
